# nemau completion

Generate the autocompletion script for nemau for the specified shell.
See each sub-command's help for details on how to use the generated script.

## Usage

```
nemau completion [command]
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [bash](nemau_completion_bash.md) | Generate the autocompletion script for bash |
| [fish](nemau_completion_fish.md) | Generate the autocompletion script for fish |
| [powershell](nemau_completion_powershell.md) | Generate the autocompletion script for powershell |
| [zsh](nemau_completion_zsh.md) | Generate the autocompletion script for zsh |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
